standard_prerequisites: Context spans: Gal(E/F) notation and the fixed field L^H

Same chapter: lemma-galois-goes-up (L/M is Galois for every subextension L/M/K of a Galois L/K), lemma-finite-goes-up (finiteness goes up), lemma-finite-Galois (finite extension is Galois iff |Aut| = degree), lemma-galois-over-fixed-field ([L : L^H] = |H| for finite H), lemma-lift-maps (restriction of automorphisms to subextensions)
core_obligations: K = L^G and the map H -> L^H from subgroups of G to subextensions L/M/K is a bijection with inverse M -> Gal(L/M)
Squeeze: for a subgroup H the two degree counts |Gal(L/M)| = [L : M] (subextensions) and [L : L^H] = |H| (fixed fields) force Gal(L/L^H) = H and L^{Gal(L/M)} = M, so the two maps are inverse
Normal H: the canonical map G/H -> Aut(L^H/K) is injective since Gal(L/L^H) = H, so |G/H| = [L^H : K] and L^H/K is Galois
Conversely M/K Galois: restriction Gal(L/K) -> Gal(M/K) is a homomorphism whose kernel is Gal(L/M), a normal subgroup
proof_roadmap: Assemble the two degree counts for subextensions and fixed fields
Conclude the bijection by the degree squeeze
Handle the normal-subgroup correspondence in both directions
